propositions: automated bug filers can spam duplicates or file on single flakes due to lack of deduplication and missing consecutive-red threshold logic
three existing auto-filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, and conflict-filer) lack stable dedup tags, templated bodies, empty-detail abort guards, and detected_by stamps
heartbeat-alert filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying workflow run history to distinguish flakes from persistent failures
binding-drift-alert filer must use accumulation+dedup without consecutive-red threshold because drift is persistent state that cannot self-heal between runs
conflict-filer must enforce stable per-conflict dedup tag, templated body, abort-if-empty, and detected_by without auto-close (requiring manual adjudication)
bug-creation contract must be documented with exact rebar create args, dedup search commands, marker-line accumulation protocol, and reference implementation for future filers
